notes.title: 🎉 "Vermin Control" is officially released! Launch discount: 20% off! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone! My first indie game, "Vermin Control", is officially launching today! 🎮🎉
This sci-fi tower defense game blends tactical strategy with direct unit control, offering a unique defense and combat experience!

📢 From the Developer
This is my first independently developed game. I started from scratch—learning programming, art, and sound design—to piece together this world.
I hope it brings you the fun of both strategy and combat! If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a review and sharing your feedback—your support means the world to an indie developer! 🙏

Thank you all for your support! 🎮🔥
